review.images: Seven native renders from The Eden’s brochure. The own tower collection includes a living room, dining space and bedroom, alongside correctly labeled shared community scenes.
review.location: Physical brochure page 33 highlights the correct tower footprint and was cross-checked against the labeled Sobha Central cluster map in The Tranquil’s brochure. The display extracts the entire site-map artwork from its facing page. All four times are from The Eden’s own project page.
